notes.title: Final Playtest is Open! Cozy Inns, New Updates, Fresh Ale
notes.content:
Raise your tankards, Innkeepers of Tidehaven!
Throw wide the gates and welcome all... Our Final Playtest begins! 


This time, we’re bringing you one of the biggest updates yet: the most advanced UI improvements and the largest batch of new content so far, right before Steam Next Fest in October. Let’s see what awaits you in this final test phase. And also we're invited to Cozy Job Simulators Event starts at 13th September, visit other indies and raise your ale with them! 🍻


[hr][/hr]

What’s Fixed?
Economy rebalancing: customer visits and consumption speed have been adjusted. With new rooms and upcoming outdoor buildings, upgrade costs and progression have also been fine-tuned.


If your inn gets filthy, expect far fewer customers to show up. Better keep things tidy,  no one wants to sit around in a stinking hall, right?


Several sound effects and texts have been refreshed. Don’t mind any strange noises… they can’t hurt you.


Certain animation loops have been reworked.


Fixed some UI layering errors.


Issues in certain mini-games and in-game windows have been resolved.


[hr][/hr]

What’s Updated?
The interface has been redesigned to help you quickly find what you’re looking for. You can now filter items by room at the top of the menu, and easily spot newly unlocked items with indicators.


Added bubble text for hover tooltips and quests.


The decoration menu has been improved so you can clearly see what’s unlocked and what’s already purchased.


Three new games are here to gamble your fortune (or ruin it): Dice Roll, Coin Flip, and a card game called Lower Deck.


Even more items have arrived! Alongside new drinks, around 20 new decoration units are now available. (Note: not all of these will appear in the current playtest progression; some are reserved for the full version.)


Dogs! Yes, dogs are now part of the inn life. Each player will adopt a completely random pup, meaning your companion might be different from someone else’s.


[hr][/hr]

What’s Next?
More outdoor buildings to visit are on the way.


The outside won’t stay empty for long — starting with the next major update, the town will feel more alive with new activities and interactions.


A brand-new quest mechanic is being tested, introducing darker, riskier, but also more thrilling scenarios.


The tutorial system will launch with the demo.


You’ll soon be able to name the animals you bring into your inn.


Save system is coming! Multiple saves will allow you to experiment with different play styles starting from the demo.


New music and ambient sounds are being added to help your inn hum along in the background while you focus on other things.


And of course, countless improvements and UI updates are on the horizon.

Thank you for being part of our first game. Your feedback, bugs, and insights mean the world to us. Please don't hesitate to join us on our Discord server and ask your questions to our dev team. And remember to add TIDEHAVEN: Ale & Trade to your wishlist! See you in the next post!

notes.title: Playtest #2 Begins – Step Outside and Build Your Stable & Pet Horses!
notes.content:
Hear Ye, Innkeepers of Tidehaven!
It’s time to swing open the doors once again. Playtest #2 has begun!
And this time, the doors open outward, too. You’ll now step beyond the walls of your inn to build your  Stable, raising horses and unlocking a whole new way to grow your gold.

Let’s take a quick look at what’s new in this second testing phase:
[hr][/hr] What's Fixed?
Fixed placement issues with several furniture items.

Resolved wall placement bugs affecting a few decorations.

Room layout problems have been corrected across multiple areas.

Some text issues and typos erased from books.
[hr][/hr] What's Updated?
The world expands! The interior buildings are no longer the final frontier. You can now begin growing your business beyond your inn and into the town.

The first of 9 upcoming outer buildings, the Stable, is now live! Raise real historical horse breeds and sell them to visiting customers for extra income. This is just the beginning, more rare, epic and legendary tier horse types and surprises are on the way!

Sound effects have been completed and polished (Almost!). Your experience should now feel as rich as a cellar full of ale barrels.

Economy balancing has been reworked, though we’ve still got a long road ahead. Prices and build times may continue to shift during testing.

A full rework of the Warehouse system is live!
→ A new Warehouse NPC now helps manage your stock.
→ The more shelves and storage units you build, the more goods you can store.
→ The assistant will auto-purchase missing ingredients, keeping your kitchen running smoothly.

New visitors! As your inn’s fame spreads, new guest types will begin to arrive, each new face is a clue toward mechanics we’re preparing to introduce soon.
[hr][/hr] What's Next?
Some of the promised features (like card and dice games) didn’t quite meet our standards just yet, so we’re moving them to the September demo release instead.

But we’re hard at work on:

A detailed tutorial system

Over 20 new decoration items

New outdoor workplaces to expand your medieval economy

Improved tooltips and more UI clarity
[hr][/hr]
To the nearly 400 players who joined our first Playtest—thank you! And to those continuing with us into this new testing week, we send you barrels of gratitude for enduring the occasional (and mildly annoying) bugs and sharing your feedback.

See you at the stable or laid drunk in the bedroom.

notes.title: Weekly Update & Fixes
notes.content:
Greetings, Keepers of Tidehaven!
As we near the end of the Playtest, we’re rolling out a small update packed with fixes and improvements—thanks to your feedback and the remaining items on our list.
[hr][/hr]What's Fixed?
Bed placement and spawn issues in the Bedroom have been resolved.

Walls no longer change color at random.

That wild wall cabinet in the Bedroom? No more transforming into a medieval Optimus Prime.

Fixed an issue where the item menu opened while painting the floor.

Fixed a decoration bug related to the Wooden Cask item.

Simple Wooden Work Table rotation issue is now working as intended.

Minor placement issues in the Kitchen have been corrected.

The Bartender’s Auto-Buy setting no longer resets after closing the game.

Fixed the placement bug with the Kitchen Shelf item.

Fireplace audio bug is resolved.

The infamous Always-on-Top bug is no more.

The Switch Monitor key is now functional, jump between screens as you please!
[hr][/hr]What's Updated?
Customization options like columns, wall panels, and floor tiles are now fully integrated into the in-game economy.

Several items can now be used in more room types.

Cooking speed and dish prices have been rebalanced.

Adjusted the price of various items.

A major sound overhaul is in progress—many new effects are now in, with more coming in future patches.

Auto-save frequency has been increased, helping protect your progress during unexpected shutdowns.
[hr][/hr]What’s Next?
We promised fast-paced improvements and the next wave is a big one:

Beyond the Inn: Starting in the first week of August, you'll step outside and begin shaping your Town, establishing new businesses beyond your inn’s cozy walls.

Horse Breeding: One of our animal-focused features is arriving soon. Build your Stable, raise fine horses, and trade them for serious coin.

Mini Games: Three new activities—Coin Flip, Dice Roll, and a card game called Lower Hand—are being added for players who just have to gamble away their hard-earned gold.

Even more furniture, food & drink, and Warehouse automation for restocking depleted goods are on the way, alongside essential balance updates and polish.

A hearty thanks to all ye who joined the Playtest! Your keen eyes and brave bug-slaying have shaped Tidehaven. We raise our mugs to you!

Please don't hesitate to join us on our Discord server and ask your questions to our dev team. And remember to add TIDEHAVEN: Ale & Trade to your wishlist! See you in the next post!

notes.title: TIDEHAVEN: ALE & TRADE First Playtest Has Begun!
notes.content:
Welcome to the first Playtest of TIDEHAVEN: ALE & TRADE!
In this early glimpse into Tidehaven, we’re excited to share the foundations of the world we’re building—where coastal winds meet tankards of ale and the hum of trade. Set between the 15th and 17th centuries, Tidehaven invites you to shape the story of a small seaside inn as it grows into a bustling cornerstone of medieval hospitality. 
In this playtest most of the features not presented yet, economy on steroids so lots of new balances on the way during playtest and at August.

What Awaits You in This Playtest:
Step-by-step inn expansion! Experience how your humble inn grows room by room, adding a Kitchen, Bedroom, Warehouse, and more as you progress.

Multiple play styles. Whether you obsess over every candle placement and renovate inch by inch, or go full entrepreneur mode chasing coin and upgrades, the game’s core systems are ready to tested by you.

Decorating with purpose. Help us test limited-time furnishings and placement logic as we refine how your inn becomes the most charming (and efficient) spot in Tidehaven.

Economy under pressure. As someone might have said (or not)—money makes the mugs go 'round. For the test, we’ve sped up the economy so you can dive deep into the systems quickly. But we’ll need your eyes and feedback to catch what’s off-balance or broken.

NPCs and item placements. NPC movement and object interactions are mostly stable. That said, we know some bold characters are walking across tables that don’t belong to them...
[hr][/hr]Known Bugs
NPCs may wander into places they clearly shouldn't. We're hopeful they'll start respecting boundaries soon.

Some furniture may overlap oddly, especially on floor surfaces. Until we fix layering, we kindly ask you not to seat guests inside each other.

The Switch Monitor isn’t functioning at the moment—it’s on the fix-it-soon list.

Hover texts and minor UI prompts are incomplete or buggy in spots.

A few rogue pixels under the bottom UI are staging a quiet rebellion. Visual layering issues are all queued for polishing.

Many sound effects are currently missing. We’ll be adding immersive (but not ear-piercing) audio soon.

Lower parts of some walls and columns show texture stretching or clarity issues—we’re working on smoothing those out.
[hr][/hr]What’s Coming Next?
The world beyond your door! Tidehaven doesn’t end at the threshold. Soon, you’ll step outside and explore new buildings—starting with the Stable, which will open during this playtest.

Mini Games! As promised, a little mischief is on the way. Spend your coins in one of three upcoming mini-games: Coin Flip, Dice Roll, and Law Draw—all arriving during this playtest.

More furniture, food, and design materials are on the way, with several items already queued to join your inventory soon.

Warehouse automation is about to get exciting. The Auto-Buy feature introduced at Inn Level 2 for the Bartender is being expanded—soon your warehouse will stock and operate even when you’re idle.

The Warehouse will no longer be a cold, lonely space—it’s becoming a living system with supply limits, restocking mechanics, and more.

Did you know every NPC has a name? Soon, they’ll be visible—bringing the world more personality and a few amusing references along the way.

Your very own dog is almost ready to wag its tail just for you! We're hoping to add a feature where you can name and bond with a loyal companion. No promises—but it's high on our list. (And just one of many animal-related features to come!)
[hr][/hr]
We’re hard at work on even more content that will arrive after the Playtest. As we participate in open beta test periods and join to upcoming festivals, we’ll be sharing Tidehaven with a wider audience—and you’re helping us lay the foundation.

Major improvements, bug fixes, and economy balancing will continue to roll out with regular updates.

Thank you for being part of our first game. Your feedback, bugs, and insights mean the world to us. Please don't hesitate to join us on our Discord server and ask your questions to our dev team. And remember to add TIDEHAVEN: Ale & Trade to your wishlist! See you in the next post!
